query.adql:
SELECT TOP 300000
  g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_over_error,
  g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.ruwe,
  g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, d.r_med_photogeo
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
JOIN external.gaiaedr3_distance AS d ON g.source_id = d.source_id
WHERE g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.ruwe < 1.4
  AND g.parallax_over_error > 1
  AND ABS(g.b) < 25
  AND g.l BETWEEN 90 AND 270
  AND d.r_med_photogeo > 6000
ORDER BY g.random_index

SELECT TOP 300000
  g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_over_error,
  g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.ruwe,
  g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, d.r_med_photogeo
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
JOIN external.gaiaedr3_distance AS d ON g.source_id = d.source_id
WHERE g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.ruwe < 1.4
  AND g.parallax_over_error > 3
  AND ABS(g.b) < 25
  AND d.r_med_photogeo IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.random_index

SELECT TOP 300000
  g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_over_error,
  g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.ruwe,
  g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, d.r_med_photogeo
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
JOIN external.gaiaedr3_distance AS d ON g.source_id = d.source_id
WHERE g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.ruwe < 1.4
  AND g.parallax_over_error > 3
  AND ABS(g.b) < 25
  AND d.r_med_photogeo > 3500
ORDER BY g.random_index
